description: Held-out bugs authored after the rules freeze; hidden oracle tests are not present in the repositories REPRO sees.

entries.name: Adjacent sums walk past the last element
entries.hidden_bug: pair_sums iterates over range(len(values)) and reads values[i + 1], so the final index is out of range.
entries.expected_behavior: pair_sums([1, 2, 3]) returns [3, 5]; empty and single inputs return an empty list.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Iterate over range(len(values) - 1).

entries.name: Page window returns one extra item
entries.hidden_bug: page() ends the slice at start + size + 1, so every page contains size + 1 items and overlaps the next page.
entries.expected_behavior: page(items, 2, 10) returns exactly items[10:20].
entries.ground_truth_summary: Use start + size as the slice end.

entries.name: last_n returns n+1 items
entries.hidden_bug: last_n slices with -n - 1, returning one more element than requested; it also mishandles n = 0.
entries.expected_behavior: last_n([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2) returns [4, 5] and n=0 returns [].
entries.ground_truth_summary: Return [] for n <= 0, otherwise values[-n:].

entries.name: Chunker uses size-1 as the chunk width
entries.hidden_bug: chunks() slices values[i:i + size - 1] while stepping by size, so it drops the final item of every chunk and produces empty chunks for size 1.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Slice at i + size and reject size <= 0.

entries.name: Sliding-window maximum omits the final window
entries.hidden_bug: max_windows iterates range(len(values) - width) instead of adding one, so the last full window is never evaluated.
entries.expected_behavior: max_windows([1, 3, 2, 5], 2) returns [3, 3, 5].
entries.ground_truth_summary: Iterate over the correct number of windows and validate width.

entries.name: Discount excludes exactly 100
entries.hidden_bug: discount() uses `total > 100` instead of `total >= 100`, so an order of exactly 100 misses the advertised discount.
entries.expected_behavior: discount(100) returns 90.0; discount(99.99) returns 99.99.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Use >= in the threshold comparison.

entries.name: Retry predicate compares in the wrong direction
entries.hidden_bug: can_retry() returns attempts > limit instead of attempts < limit, so it allows retries after the limit and blocks the first attempt.
entries.expected_behavior: can_retry(0, 3) is True and can_retry(3, 3) is False.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Compare attempts < limit.

entries.name: Temperature check uses an impossible chained comparison
entries.hidden_bug: in_range() evaluates `-40 < t > 125`, which can never be true, instead of checking that t lies between the inclusive bounds.
entries.expected_behavior: in_range(20) is True; both -40 and 125 are inclusive.

entries.name: Password minimum is off by one
entries.hidden_bug: valid_password() requires len(password) > 8, rejecting the documented eight-character minimum.
entries.expected_behavior: valid_password('12345678') is True; seven characters is False.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Use >= 8.

entries.name: Grade boundaries use strict comparisons
entries.hidden_bug: grade() uses `score > 90` and `score > 80`, so exactly 90 is a B and exactly 80 is a C, contradicting the published cutoffs.
entries.expected_behavior: 90 is an A, 80 is a B, 70 is a C, and 69 is an F.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Make the A and B comparisons inclusive.

entries.name: Missing address crashes profile lookup
entries.hidden_bug: city() indexes user['address']['city'] without allowing a missing or null address.
entries.expected_behavior: A user without an address, or with a null city, returns 'unknown'.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Guard the address lookup and default to 'unknown'.

entries.name: Average divides by the wrong count when values are null
entries.hidden_bug: average() sums with None values in the list and divides by the original length instead of ignoring missing readings; an empty list divides by zero.
entries.expected_behavior: average([1, None, 3]) is 2.0 and average([]) is 0.0.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Filter None, return 0.0 when nothing remains.

entries.name: Explicit null timeout bypasses the default
entries.hidden_bug: timeout() uses dict.get(key, default), which returns None when the key exists with a null value; callers then get None instead of 30.
entries.expected_behavior: A missing or null timeout returns 30; an explicit 0 is preserved.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Check for None explicitly rather than relying on the get default.

entries.name: Guest orders crash on the customer name
entries.hidden_bug: customer_name() dereferences order.customer.name without handling a null customer.
entries.expected_behavior: An order with no customer returns 'guest'; a customer with no name also returns 'guest'.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Guard the customer and name lookups.

entries.name: Null items payload is not normalized
entries.hidden_bug: items() indexes payload['items'], so a missing key raises KeyError and a null value returns None instead of an empty list.
entries.expected_behavior: A missing or null items field returns [].
entries.ground_truth_summary: Use .get('items') or [].

entries.name: Adding a tag mutates the caller's list
entries.hidden_bug: with_tag() appends to the caller's list and returns the same object, so constructing a tagged copy changes the original.
entries.expected_behavior: with_tag(['a'], 'b') returns ['a', 'b'] without modifying ['a'].
entries.ground_truth_summary: Build and return a new list.

entries.name: Ordering helper sorts the caller's list in place
entries.hidden_bug: ordered() calls list.sort() on the argument and returns the same list, silently reordering the caller's data.
entries.expected_behavior: ordered([3, 1, 2]) returns [1, 2, 3] while the input stays [3, 1, 2].
entries.ground_truth_summary: Return sorted(values) instead of sorting in place.

entries.name: Mutable default argument leaks items across calls
entries.hidden_bug: add_item() uses a mutable default list, so items accumulate between calls that do not pass an explicit bucket.
entries.expected_behavior: Two separate calls with no bucket each return a one-item list.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Use None as the sentinel and create a fresh list per call.

entries.name: Archive shallow-copies rows and mutates originals
entries.hidden_bug: archive() copies the outer list but not each row dict, so setting 'archived' on the copies also changes the caller's rows.
entries.expected_behavior: archive(rows) returns archived copies while rows stay unchanged.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Copy each row dict before mutating it.

entries.name: Grid rows alias one shared list
entries.hidden_bug: zero_grid() builds [[0] * cols] * rows, which repeats the same inner list object, so writing one cell changes every row.
entries.expected_behavior: Each grid row is an independent list.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Build each row with a separate comprehension.

entries.name: Quantity parser rejects values with units
entries.hidden_bug: quantity() calls int() on the whole string, so '3 items' raises ValueError instead of reading the numeric prefix.
entries.expected_behavior: quantity('3 items') returns 3; a bare number still works.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Take the first whitespace-separated token before int().

entries.name: Label concatenates an integer user id
entries.hidden_bug: label() concatenates str and int, raising TypeError for numeric ids.
entries.expected_behavior: label(42) returns 'user-42'; string ids keep working.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Format the id instead of concatenating it directly.

entries.name: Price total assumes numeric strings
entries.hidden_bug: total() sums raw values, so decimal strings from the billing feed raise TypeError and integer prices are not mixed correctly.
entries.expected_behavior: total(['1.5', '2.5']) returns 4.0; mixed ints and strings work.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Convert every price to float before summing.

entries.name: Lookup does not normalize string keys
entries.hidden_bug: lookup() indexes a dict with integer keys using the string form, raising KeyError for feed ids that arrive as strings.
entries.expected_behavior: lookup({1: 'a'}, '1') returns 'a'; an unknown key still raises.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Try the key as given, then as an int, and re-raise KeyError.

entries.name: Score sorter cannot compare ints and strings
entries.hidden_bug: sorted_scores() calls sorted() on a mixed list of ints and numeric strings, which raises TypeError in Python 3.
entries.expected_behavior: Mixed scores sort numerically while preserving their original values.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Sort with a float-converting key.

entries.name: Withdrawal subtracts the amount twice
entries.hidden_bug: Account.withdraw() subtracts the amount twice, so a 30 withdrawal from 100 leaves 40 instead of 70.
entries.expected_behavior: One withdrawal reduces the balance by exactly the requested amount.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Remove the duplicated balance update.

entries.name: Switch press sets on instead of toggling
entries.hidden_bug: Switch.press() assigns True instead of negating the current state, so a second press leaves the switch on.
entries.expected_behavior: Each press flips the state; two presses return to off.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Assign `not self.on`.

entries.name: Releasing a reservation consumes stock
entries.hidden_bug: release() subtracts from available instead of adding back, so returning reserved stock decreases the sellable quantity.
entries.expected_behavior: Releasing n units increases available by n and decreases reserved by n.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Add released units back to available.

entries.name: Successful retry increments the attempt counter twice
entries.hidden_bug: Retrier.attempt() increments attempts before the success branch and again inside it, so a success is counted as two attempts.
entries.expected_behavior: Each call counts as exactly one attempt, regardless of outcome.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Remove the second increment.

entries.name: Adding an existing SKU overwrites its quantity
entries.hidden_bug: Cart.add() assigns the new quantity instead of adding it to the existing quantity for the same SKU.
entries.expected_behavior: Adding 3 then 2 of a SKU leaves a quantity of 5.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Accumulate with self.items.get(sku, 0) + qty.

entries.name: Serializer uses a field the model does not have
entries.hidden_bug: User.full_name() returns only the first name, and serialize() reads the nonexistent user.name attribute, so profile serialization crashes.
entries.expected_behavior: full_name() returns 'Ada Lovelace' and serialize() exposes it as name.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Build the full name in the model and use full_name() in the serializer.

entries.name: Plugin registered under a name the manifest does not use
entries.hidden_bug: The alpha plugin exports NAME='alpha-v1' but the registry hardcodes the key 'alpha'; the plugin's run() also adds instead of doubles.
entries.expected_behavior: The plugin is discoverable by its exported name and doubles its input.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Register by NAME and fix the plugin's arithmetic.

entries.name: Checkout applies the tax rate as a flat surcharge
entries.hidden_bug: The configured tax rate is 20% instead of 10%, and checkout adds the rate as a flat amount rather than multiplying the subtotal.
entries.expected_behavior: A 100 subtotal with 10% tax totals 110.0.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Set the rate to 0.1 and compute subtotal * (1 + rate).

entries.name: Handler subscribes to a misspelled topic
entries.hidden_bug: The event bus publishes to TOPIC='user.created' but the handler registers for 'user-created', so no subscriber is ever called.
entries.expected_behavior: Publishing TOPIC invokes the registered handler exactly once.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Subscribe using the shared TOPIC constant.

entries.name: Repository reads a renamed model field
entries.hidden_bug: The User model stores the address as email_address, but the repository's email_of() still reads the old 'email' key and raises KeyError.
entries.expected_behavior: email_of() reads email_address from a serialized user.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Read the renamed field in the repository.

entries.name: Fetch helper converts every failure into None
entries.hidden_bug: fetch() catches every exception and returns None, so callers cannot distinguish a missing value from a broken client.
entries.expected_behavior: Client errors propagate; a successful response is returned unchanged.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Remove the broad except and let the client exception propagate.

entries.name: Integer parser hides invalid input as zero
entries.hidden_bug: parse() catches ValueError and returns 0, so malformed input silently becomes a valid zero instead of raising.
entries.expected_behavior: parse('x') raises ValueError; parse('3') returns 3.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Remove the except and let int() raise.

entries.name: Ratio helper turns division by zero into zero
entries.hidden_bug: ratio() catches ZeroDivisionError and returns 0, hiding an invalid denominator instead of letting the error reach the caller.
entries.expected_behavior: A zero denominator raises ZeroDivisionError; normal division works.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Remove the exception handler.

entries.name: Failed transaction leaves earlier items committed
entries.hidden_bug: Store.add_all() appends items one by one before validating the whole batch, so an invalid item leaves a partial commit behind.
entries.expected_behavior: If any item is None, add_all raises and the store is unchanged.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Validate the full batch before mutating the store.

entries.name: User parser silently skips malformed rows
entries.hidden_bug: parse_users() catches KeyError and continues, so a missing name silently drops a user instead of failing the import.
entries.expected_behavior: A row without name raises ValueError; valid rows are returned.
entries.ground_truth_summary: Validate the name field and raise ValueError instead of skipping.
